Position Overview As a Store Floor Lead at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this leadership role, the StoreFloor Lead supports the General Manager (GM) or Store Manager (SM) in achieving sales and operational goals. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Lead the sales floor and oversee daily store operations as Manager on Duty (MOD). · Provides in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b9f9b4cf-194f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Culinary Operations & Food Systems based in United Kingdom. This is a senior culinary leadership role focused on building the systems that make food quality, safety, and consistency scalable across multiple locations. You will assess culinary operations, identify urgent product and quality issues, and establish practical standards that can withstand growth and team turnover. The role combines culinary expertise with operational discipline, covering recipes, specifications, food safety, menu performance, training, suppliers, and food economics. Rather than managing daily kitchen execution, you will provide remote leadership through on-site culinary leaders and location teams. You will use data and modern technology to diagnose problems, improve processes, and make informed decisions about products and menus. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Partnerships Strategy Manager will support commercial strategy and analysis for the Global Partnerships organization, helping the business evaluate its portfolio, identify growth opportunities, and understand its position in market. This role focuses on turning performance data, market trends, and competitive intelligence into actionable insights and recommendations — and helping ensure those insights inform how the partnerships business goes to market. The Manager will work closely with sales, analytics, and leadership to support commercial decision-making, with go-to-market materials as a natural output of that work rather than the primary focus.
